maintenance_led.reason: Sells instruments, reagents, test kits and quality controls for research and diagnostics; mostly consumables and new product sales, not repair services.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are clinical labs, hospitals, pharma/biotech and research institutions; final payers mostly private and commercial, though some academic grants.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own life science and diagnostics products, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Validated diagnostic assays, blood typing, QC controls and ddPCR workflows need re-validation and regulatory requalification to switch.

notes: Revenue mix between recurring reagents and instruments is not stated on the page; maintenance_led and publicly_funded rely on general knowledge.
